overview: ZCHEM LAB is a premium futuristic chemistry learning platform featuring an interactive 118-element periodic table, 4 chemistry calculation tools with animations, a virtual litmus/indicator test lab, an NCERT-aligned burner lab with animated experiments, and a worksheet generator. All data is embedded for offline use.
features: 118-element interactive periodic table with Bohr model animations
Equation balancer with Taraju weighing scale visualization
Molar mass calculator with element breakdown
pH calculator with animated color bar
Virtual litmus & indicator test lab with beaker animations
NCERT virtual burner lab with 5 animated experiments
Futuristic dark UI with neon accents and glassmorphism
